notes: All built materials remain opaque; the shared runtime owns the preserved windscreen/side-glass and actual mirror reflection.
Eye, wheel/rim, wiper, speed and radio needle, recorder readout and control locations are unchanged.
All meshes except cabin and radio preserve exact accessor bytes and material channels from the saved before asset.
